# viettelcloud_fs_filesystem_snapshot_policy (Data Source)

Get one Viettel Cloud File Storage filesystem snapshot policy by ID or exact filter criteria.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "viettelcloud_fs_filesystem_snapshot_policy" "nightly" {
  name   = "example-nightly"
  region = "vn-central-1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Snapshot policy ID (UUID).
- `name` (String) Snapshot policy name to filter by.
- `region` (String) Project region name to filter by.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC3339).
- `days_of_week` (List of String) Days of the week on which the policy takes a snapshot.
- `description` (String) Snapshot policy description.
- `filesystem_count` (Number) Number of filesystems that use the policy.
- `owner_id` (String) Owner ID (UUID).
- `project_id` (String) Project ID (UUID).
- `region_id` (String) Region ID (UUID).
- `region_name` (String) Region name that the backend reports.
- `retention` (Number) Number of snapshots the policy keeps.
- `state` (String) State of the latest policy run.
- `status` (String) Policy status: enabled or disabled.
- `time` (String) Time of day in UTC at which the policy takes a snapshot.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time (RFC3339).
